newsitem.title: USA: Transworld buys Health Management stock.
newsitem.headline: Transworld buys Health Management stock.

text.p: Transworld Home HealthCare Inc said Tuesday it had closed a stock purchase agreement it had reached with Health Management Inc as part of their merger.
Transworld said it had bought about 9.0 million newly issued shares, or 49 percent of Health Management's common stock, at $1.00 each.
Transworld also said it also had the option to acquire up to an additional 746,713 shares, or 2.0 percent, of its common stock.
The company said the merger agreement would likely close in the "spring of 1997."
Transworld Home HealthCare Inc is a regional provider of alternate site healthcare services and products.
Health Management Inc is a national provider of integrated pharmacy management services to patients including those with chronic medical conditions.
